How is onboarding with IMPACT different from going directly through HubSpot?

HubSpot’s own onboarding provides technical and strategic guidance tailored to your goals. With IMPACT, the emphasis is practical coaching in your own portal, connecting the setup to your sales and marketing processes and helping your team learn how and why it works. We’ll clarify the setup work, training, and responsibilities included in your engagement before you begin.

Before you begin

A few questions, answered.

How long does HubSpot onboarding take?

We’ll agree on a timeline before you begin, based on your hubs, setup needs, team availability, and time to practice between sessions. Your package’s schedule is confirmed during scoping.

Will IMPACT do the setup, or will our team?

Our approach combines practical guidance with learning in your own HubSpot portal. Before kickoff, we’ll define the setup tasks IMPACT will handle and the work your team will own, so everyone knows their responsibilities.

Are migrations and integrations included?

Migration, integrations, and additional implementation are scoped separately. If you need to move data or connect other tools, we’ll discuss those requirements alongside your onboarding plan.

Do we need to join another IMPACT program?

No. HubSpot onboarding can be a standalone engagement. We’ll focus on the platform skills and setup your team needs, without requiring you to join another IMPACT program.
